service_update_order.rule: Run the task-49 server-side PostgreSQL password action, prove new authentication, then recreate dependent consumers in a stopped state.
Recreate each server with its new environment first; run its task-50 deferred server-side credential action before a dependent consumer starts.
Force-recreate stopped consumers after the activation manifest is frozen; a restart alone cannot load an env-only change.
Recreate only the approved stopped set after phases 1-3 and before bounded canaries.

env_only_rule: An env-only change requires a force-recreate of the approved stopped consumer; docker compose restart is not evidence that the new value was loaded.
production_gate: No server-side change, environment edit, or container recreation is permitted until the task-49 activation manifest and explicit owner authorization exist.
